task_completion.description: The agent successfully loads the chest CT and identifies the pre-placed 'Nodule' fiducial.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Slicer 3D interface showing a loaded CT volume and a visible fiducial marker labeled 'Nodule' in the 2D or 3D views.

task_completion.description: The agent scrolls through the CT slices to count ribs and identify anatomical variants.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent navigating through axial, sagittal, or coronal slices, specifically focusing on the costovertebral junctions.

task_completion.description: The agent places reference fiducials at the centers of T1, T6, and T12 vertebral bodies.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Three new fiducial markers visible in the Markups list or 3D view, ideally labeled T1, T6, and T12, positioned within the vertebral bodies.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the vertebral landmarks to the specified JSON file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' dialog box or a terminal command showing the path ~/Documents/SlicerData/LIDC/vertebral_landmarks.mrk.json being used.

task_completion.description: The agent exports a report with the required fields (rib counts, variants, nodule level).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output showing the content of ~/Documents/SlicerData/LIDC/rib_count_report.json containing fields like total_rib_pairs, anatomical_variants, and nodule_vertebral_level.

integrity.description: The agent used the Slicer GUI to place markers rather than just writing a script to generate the file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Mouse cursor movements, active markup placement tools in the Slicer toolbar, and manual clicking on vertebral bodies.

integrity.description: The agent actually navigated to the nodule location to determine its level.
integrity.visual_evidence: The slice viewer coordinates changing to center on the 'Nodule' fiducial before the report is written.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the privileged information into the report without looking at the scan.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent performing measurements or scrolling through the spine to verify the T1-T12 span.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The standard anatomy for LIDC-IDRI-0001 contains 12 pairs of ribs. The distance between the T1 and T12 fiducials should be between 200mm and 320mm. The report must include specific fields: total_rib_pairs (expected 12), anatomical_variants (cervical_rib, lumbar_rib, bifid_rib), and the nodule_vertebral_level.
